Section: Use of automated means for content moderation
Indicator: Number of measures solely taken by automated means
Contextual Information: The only content moderation process that is entirely automated for Pokémon GO is when a Route fails our location classifier. A Pokémon GO Route is a path that players can follow to explore their local area. Routes can be created by Niantic, official partners or other players. If the classifiers identify a Route to be an unsafe, inaccessible, or private location as determined by our location classifier, the Route will be auto-rejected. Upon rejection, a user receives a notification that contains the reason why the Route was rejected. If a Route is rejected, a user also has the opportunity to appeal that decision. More information about Routes can be found in the Help Center: https://niantic.helpshift.com/hc/en/6-pokemon-go/faq/4175-what-are-routes/.  There were no notices processed by automated means.

Contextual Information: All of the classifiers used on content which is reportable under DSA are third party providers and we rely on those companies to ensure adequate tuning and improvements to the model. There is not just one reportable percentage but rather the metrics are tied to each specific category of action (DRUGS, SEXUAL, HATE_SPEECH, etc.) per third party classifier.
